issue.body:
When running the dump command, include the specific configuration file
provided as part of the backup. Currently we only zip up custom/ and this
misses the config file if it is somewhere else, like /etc/gitea/app.ini

Fixes #6034

body:
Is there already a solution?

My current workaround is to add the custom configuration file /etc/gitea/app.ini with the command 'zip -r gitea-dump-...zip /etc/gitea/app.ini' in a script.

Kind regards,
K1LLUM1N471
Fix will be included in v1.9.0
